title: How to Mail a Letter Without a Printer
description: No printer, envelope or stamps? Write or upload the letter online and have it printed and mailed for you. What file types work and what to check first.
keywords: mail a letter without a printer
send a letter without a printer
answer: Write the letter in a document or the editor on an online mailing service, add the addresses, and pay. The service prints it, puts it in an envelope, stamps it and mails it. You need a PDF or Word file, or just type it into the site, but no printer, envelope or stamp.

ul: **A PDF.** Up to 200 pages and 40 MB.
**A Word (.docx) file.** Up to 40 pages. It is converted to pages, so check the preview: Word layouts can shift in conversion.
**Text typed on the site.** A built-in editor with basic formatting, for a plain letter.
**Preview.** The site shows what will print before you pay.

ol: Open the preview and read every page; it shows what will print.
Make sure the recipient's postal code is correct. A wrong one raises the postage and can delay delivery.
Put your own return address in the sender fields, so an undeliverable letter can come back: see [return addresses](/blog/return-address-on-a-canadian-letter).
Pick black and white unless colour matters; colour costs $0.50 a page against $0.15.

sections.h2: Other ways to get it printed

blocks.p: A library or print shop will print a page for a small fee, and you would then still need an envelope and a stamp. [What an online letter costs](/blog/what-an-online-letter-costs) shows the all-in figure, and [how online mailing works](/blog/how-online-letter-mailing-works) walks through the steps.
